scripts.dev: concurrently -n "WEB,API" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w farha-web" "npm run dev -w farha-api"
scripts.deploy:dev: cd apps/api && npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml && cd ../.. && npm run build:dev -w farha-web && cd apps/web && npx wrangler pages deploy .vercel/output/static --project-name dev-farha --branch=dev
scripts.deploy:prod: cd apps/api && npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.prod.toml && cd ../.. && npm run build:prod -w farha-web && cd apps/web && npx wrangler pages deploy .vercel/output/static --project-name farha --branch=main
scripts.db:init-local: cd apps/api && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=../../schema.sql
scripts.db:init-dev: cd apps/api && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=../../schema.sql --config wrangler.toml
scripts.db:init-prod: cd apps/api && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=../../schema.sql --config wrangler.prod.toml
